change: The legacy manual Kabsch panel now leaves ICP refinement disabled by default. The operator may still opt in with the existing checkbox; the split-screen manual point workflow already submits apply_icp_refinement=false.
why: A manual tie-point transform should preserve the transform calculated from the manually selected pairs unless the operator explicitly requests geometry-based ICP refinement.

verification.red: The new policy regression initially failed because the tested policy module was absent.

acceptance.reason: No independent survey control points or agreed engineering tolerance are available; RMSE < 10 mm is not verified.
